defaults.video_script: Barcelona needed a goal and the ball came in high. Lionel Messi jumped, and instead of heading it, he punched it into the net with his fist. The referee gave the goal. Nobody on the pitch seemed to notice. Messi ran away celebrating like nothing had happened. It was almost exactly what Maradona had done to England twenty one years earlier. Afterwards Messi admitted it. The goal was never taken away.

videos.video_subject: In 2007 Lionel Messi scored against Espanyol by punching the ball into the net with his fist, the referee allowed it, and it was compared to Maradona's Hand of God goal from 1986
videos.video_script: Barcelona needed a goal and the ball came in high. Lionel Messi jumped, and instead of heading it, he punched it into the net with his fist. The referee gave the goal. Nobody on the pitch seemed to notice. Messi ran away celebrating like nothing had happened. It was almost exactly what Maradona had done to England twenty one years earlier. Afterwards Messi admitted it. The goal was never taken away.
